pitfalls: 1) Codex host-2 found real proof-or-stop gaps all 3 Claude lanes missed across 3 rounds: F-002 (concurrent driver's precondition_failed contaminated the campaign ledger; end-of-run guard ignored EXTRA records) and F-003 (a crash OUTSIDE the guarded body — mkdtemp/append/cleanup — escaped uncaught, skipping the guard). Quality corroborated (F-001 generate-crash, F-004 mkdtemp-before-try). 2) The converging fix is STRUCTURAL: guard the WHOLE iteration lifecycle + run a defensive strict-multiset end-of-run guard in a finally/top-level backstop so the driver NEVER exits 0 with a missing/extra/dup record wherever a crash occurs. 3) Digests MUST be sourced from the generation-side manifest, not verifier stability booleans, or H1 is meaningless. 4) A lock-blocked driver records precondition_failed to a SEPARATE blocked-ledger, not the campaign ledger. 5) The full campaign (~5-8min, 3x 1M) must be re-run after any driver change so the committed ledger is producible by the committed driver.
